title: Viktor Tikhonov
summary: Viktor Tikhonov is a name associated with multiple notable individuals, particularly in the context of Ukrainian politics and sports.

sections.heading: Viktor Tikhonov (Politician)
paragraphs: Viktor Tikhonov (1949–2020) was a prominent [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] politician who served as a member of parliament and held the position of ambassador. His contributions to Ukrainian politics during his lifetime are significant, reflecting the political landscape of [[ukraine|Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Viktor Tikhonov (Ice Hockey Player and Coach)
paragraphs: Viktor Tikhonov (1930–2014) was a distinguished Soviet ice hockey player and coach. His career in ice hockey is notable, and he played a significant role in the development of the sport in the [[post-soviet-states|former Soviet Union]], which included Ukraine.

sections.heading: Viktor Tikhonov (Ice Hockey Player, Born 1988)
paragraphs: Viktor Tikhonov, born in 1988, is a Russian ice hockey player and the grandson of Viktor Vasilyevich Tikhonov (1930–2014). While primarily associated with Russian ice hockey, the legacy of his grandfather's influence on the sport extends to the broader region, including Ukraine.
